review.note: Reviewed every direct build, runtime, development and Node dependency, including candidates outside existing bounds. Compared with the preceding 0.23.1 receipt: all non-Core latest candidates and Python 3.14 support are unchanged; prior official release-note reviews remain applicable. Public PyPI JSON discovery returned Core 0.44.0 at this audit time; the user-provided NAS resolver log independently shows an index already selecting 0.45.0. That discovery difference is not evidence that 0.45.0 is unpublished. This task uses an explicit Core 0.45.0 wheel built from reviewed Core commit 0ec9a49, SHA256 255180d5bd152b4744a6f3932f354e110e6b621c86f211854978780089ffc8ba. Core 0.45 changes diagnostic telemetry and internal analysis queries, with schema 9 and public queue facade contracts unchanged; Downloader does not parse the changed telemetry. The supported range preserves tested Core 0.43/0.44 and adds 0.45 while rejecting schema-8 releases and the unreviewed 0.46 lane. 17 focused cases passed against installed Core 0.45, covering actual SQLite public facade queue polling, exact token replacement, stale completion rejection and handoff, plus the new regression rejecting the previous <0.45 bound. A fresh runtime venv normally resolved the actual Core 0.45 and Downloader 0.23.2 wheels with transitive dependencies, without --no-deps; installed-wheel metadata/public export smoke and uv pip check passed. No runtime implementation, public API, config, data format or compatibility shim was changed. Final repository gate and separately recorded all-role Compose candidate integration remain required; this receipt does not claim those checks, a registry-only release cohort, or production deployment. No real external account, browser or production database was accessed.
